Hi <@U0AUGEM2PK6> <@U0AU6FDG2HZ>! Have a couple of UI questions I wanted to get your thoughts on (that will be on the agenda in the design review meeting)

• `Thumbnails` - We are currently trying to work out changes to the cards in the Digest and Explore pages so that the headline overlays aren't covering so much of the thumbnails/content. For simplicity the team requested that all thumbnail cards throughout the app (digest, explore page, topic page, profile pages) to all be the same dimensions. We'd like to have one size for the Digest/Explore cards, and one size for smaller thumbnails on Topic and Profile pages - from a dev perspective, any concerns on having two different sizes? The actual thumbnail _image_ would be the same universally - it's just the size of the _card_ that we want to change so the headline overlay is beneath the thumbnail image, instead of on top of it.
• `Digest Progression` - Similarly, we want to change how we represent progression through the digest. The current design has a bar on the right hand side. This clashes with the content interactions (like, comment, share, etc) and takes up valuable space. We'd like to instead make it a circle (see <https://www.figma.com/design/kjUsvkiMGmZ2vGMMtPG0ru/Say-So--CALIBER-OWNED-?node-id=22000-84017&t=79siAKzoBpgvm1dy-4|here>) at the top of the screen, that fills based on the percentage of the user's completion. 
• `Custom tab bar` - We are currently using the iOS native bar but would like to build the custom bar that is included in our designs, which is made specifically to fit with our full screen video player. I think it was discussed last week that this would be about 2 days of effort if I remember correctly?
